published_ranges._drying: 70C >=5h (hot dry air oven) if bubbles or severe stringing occur
published_ranges._density: 1.2-1.25 g/cm3 (ISO 1183); published as a range only, so filament_density left unset
published_ranges._notes: TDS titled 'TPU95A Filament' (2024-01-18); test specimens printed on an Adventurer 5M with a 0.6 nozzle at 230C, 150 mm/s. Elongation at break 800-1000%. Continuous service temperature 90C. Support: self-supporting, PVA, BVOH. Flashforge's Filament Guide lists a 'Flexible' line at 190-230C / 20-40 mm/s with tensile 15-20 MPa (TDS: 27-28 MPa); it is unclear whether that is the same product, so it is not used here. No AMS statement published.
